id: title:fasyy612:move the collections segment to quill

review.posthog_relevance: Replacement of the internal Lemon UI library with the Quill UI library, affecting the implementation and potentially the behavior or styling of playlist and collection views.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F1.H1 demonstrates a substantive replacement of the underlying UI implementation, swapping the Lemon library for Quill. This is a bounded, implementation-level change that could affect behavior and styling, warranting a score of 2. No score of 3 is assigned because the broader systemic impact or complete behavioral equivalence is not demonstrated. No score of 1
review.uncertainty: The complete behavioral and visual consequences of this library replacement are not fully demonstrated in the supplied hunk; unverified outcomes include potential compatibility issues or changes in user interaction not shown in this specific hunk.

observations.limitations: All supplied hunks are complete and cover the relevant hunks. No missing context. No binary or generated-only hunks. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Replaces LemonButton, LemonBadge, LemonSkeleton, LemonBanner, LemonSegmentedButton, LemonInput, LemonLink with Quill equivalents (Button, Badge, Skeleton, Item, Input, LinkPrimitive, Tabs, etc.) and updates JSX structure and props.
observations.code_quote: import { Badge, Button, Item, ItemContent, ItemDescription, Skeleton } from '@posthog/quill'
observations.posthog_connection: Replaces the Lemon UI library with the Quill UI library, changing the underlying implementation and potentially the styling and behavior of the playlist and collection views.
